description: Machine-rerunnable list of the demonstrated design-mastery tasks for the next evaluation goal. Each fixture names a category, the reference file that should govern it, the built artifact, and concrete pass criteria a future run can re-check.

fixtures.task: Recreate a live-site hero section from a screenshot (screenshot-to-rebuild pipeline).
pass_criteria: Renders in a browser with no layout overflow or overlapping elements
Matches source screenshot's type scale and spacing within a few px
Contains no §2 anti-slop tells (SKILL.md)

fixtures.task: Design a pricing card UI component with a documented plan-gate decision.
pass_criteria: Renders with no overlap at standard desktop viewport
Plan-gate rejection/revision documented in plan-gate-live-test/plan-gate-test.md

fixtures.task: Design a mobile app 'Today' list screen with a bottom tab bar, 390x844 frame.
pass_criteria: Renders inside a 390x844 mobile frame with no clipped content
Tab bar and list rows do not overlap
Screenshot-verified via Chrome

fixtures.task: Design a SaaS metrics dashboard: MRR/users/churn/session cards plus a revenue-by-week bar chart.
pass_criteria: Grid layout renders with no overlap across metric cards and chart
Bar chart bars render at distinct, readable heights
Screenshot-verified via Chrome

fixtures.task: Produce a one-page brand guidelines sheet (palette, type sample, mark clearspace) for the 'Fieldnote' brand system.
pass_criteria: Palette swatches, type sample, and mark clearspace section all render without overlap
Uses the same brand tokens (colors/type) as the packaging and marketing-creative demos
Screenshot-verified via Chrome

fixtures.task: Design a standalone brand mark/logo as SVG.
pass_criteria: Valid SVG, renders cleanly at multiple sizes with no broken paths
Passed plan-gate before final form was chosen

fixtures.task: Design an editorial/poster-style visual artifact for a non-web medium.
pass_criteria: Renders as a single coherent composition with no cut-off text or graphics
Design philosophy documented in non-web-demo/design-philosophy.md
Visually inspected as a rendered PNG, not just described

fixtures.task: Design a product packaging label for the 'Fieldnote' brand, with a documented plan-gate rejection of a generic first idea.
pass_criteria: Valid SVG, renders cleanly with no overlapping text/graphics
Plan-gate decision (rejected circular-badge-gradient concept) documented in reference-library-notes.md
Screenshot-verified via local server + Chrome

fixtures.task: Design a single 1920x1080 data-forward presentation slide (Q3 results: headline + stat row).
pass_criteria: 1920x1080 canvas renders with no element overlap when viewed at full slide width
Stat row values are legible and aligned
Screenshot-verified via Chrome (viewport clipping at <1920px browser width is expected, not a defect)

fixtures.task: Design a 1080x1080 social/marketing ad for the 'Fieldnote' brand reusing its established type/color system.
pass_criteria: 1080x1080 canvas renders with no overlap between kicker, claim, and footer CTA
Uses the same brand tokens as the branding and packaging demos
Screenshot-verified via Chrome

rerun_instructions: Serve references/ locally: python3 -m http.server <port> from the design-mastery/references directory.
For each fixture with an .html artifact, navigate to http://localhost:<port>/<artifact-relative-path> and take a screenshot; confirm against pass_criteria.
For .svg artifacts, open directly in a browser tab or serve the same way.
For .png artifacts, read the file directly and visually inspect against pass_criteria.
A fixture is PASS only if pass_criteria are confirmed by an actual render/screenshot, not by reading the source code alone.
